# Global Influence Operations Report

> > Tracking state-sponsored influence operations, foreign interference, and information warfare campaigns across China, Russia, Iran, and transnational networks.

The Global Influence Operations Report (GIOR) monitors and analyzes foreign influence campaigns, disinformation operations, and strategic interference by state and non-state actors. Coverage includes Chinese soft power initiatives, Russian information warfare, Iranian operations, and the rise of national conservative movements across Europe and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Influence Operations
- Foreign Influence & Interference
- Disinformation & Information Warfare
- China (PRC) - Beijing, Xinjiang, UNESCO
- Russia - Ukraine War Context
- Iran - IRGC Operations
- Social Media Manipulation
- National Conservatism & GNCA
- European Politics & EU
- United Kingdom Sanctions & Policy
- United States - Trump Administration
- Turkey - AKP & Muslim Brotherhood
- AI-Powered Cognitive Warfare
- Cultural Diplomacy & Soft Power
- International Organizations
